rationale: manhart_pwls_tv-claude-agentic: val_n=214, rationale=iter-4 PWLS-ACTIVATION TEST. iter-3 hr=0.2071/ssim=0.9276 (gamma=1.0, tv_clip_max=0.08, tv_lambda=0.001, tv_iter=200, tv_lr=0.01) was pure TV-tuning: at tv_lambda=0.001 the TV term (lam*TV~40.7) dominates the data term (~0.04) ~1000x, so the PWLS statistical ray-weight W=exp(-gamma*p) is INERT (iter-1 g=1.0 vs iter-2 g=0.5 gave BIT-IDENTICAL results, slurm 769099/769168). DECISIVE LEVER: tv_lambda 0.001->1e-4 (10x drop -> lam*TV~4.07, still ~100x data but the data term now starts to BITE so Manharts gamma weighting can shape the recon; 10x is safer than 100x which risks noise). ONE knob; gamma=1.0 (full Manhart), tv_clip_max=0.08, tv_iter=200, tv_lr=0.01 all kept from iter-3. THESIS: if activating PWLS now BEATS plain-TVs hr=0.2085, that is the novel Manhart contribution on dense Mayo; if it cannot exceed 0.2085, PWLS adds nothing here (clean negative result). Fits hard 20-min (214 slices x 200 iters ~1160s)., tv_clip_max=0.08, tv_lambda=0.0001
